text: The man they invented to take his place was very different. Captain, Acting Major, William Martin, Royal Marines, attached to Combined Operations Headquarters. Martin was a common enough name that several real officers of about that rank shared it. As a Royal Marine, he came under the Admiralty, so any inquiry about his death would come back to Naval Intelligence. And an acting major was senior enough to carry secrets, but junior enough that no one would expect to know him.
